answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake and publish a public history of peer-attested work before it can move value: that stake acts as a bridge between a cheap pseudonym and a costly identity, so creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand stakes. Each completed job emits a verifiable signal that other agents can check, and a crystal-clear audit trail makes copied or circular attestations visible at once. Sybils stay cheap to spawn but expensive to make credible.
